children: Mumbai: IDFC First Bank's net profit grew three times to 1,045 core in the quarter ended September 2026 from 352 crore a year ago due to strong growth in both loans as well as fees. Loans, including credit substitutes and FCNR(B)-backed lending increased 30% year on year to 3.5 lakh crore. Excluding loans secured by FCNR(B) deposits, loan growth was 22%, the bank said.

IDFC First Bank's net profit grew threefold to 1,045 crore in the quarter ended September 2026 from 352 crore a year ago due to strong growth in both loans and fees. Loans, including credit substitutes and FCNR(B)-backed lending, increased 30% year on year to 3.5 lakh crore. Excluding loans secured by FCNR(B) deposits, loan growth was 22%, the bank said. As a result, net interest income (NII) increased 21% to 6,184 crore from 5,113 crore a year ago. Net interest margin (NIM) fell to 5.6% from 5.9% in the quarter ended June 2026, largely due to a 16-basis-point impact from loans given to garner FCNR(B) deposits.

title: IDFC First Bank Q2 Profit Nearly Triples to 1,045 cr
